name: open-slide
summary: Slide framework where a coding agent writes React slides on a fixed 1920 x 1080 canvas, with inspector and PDF/PPTX export.
description: Describe a deck in natural language and your coding agent writes the React pages; open-slide provides the canvas, scaling, navigation, hot reload, an in-browser inspector with comment markers, presenter mode and export to static HTML, PDF or PPTX. Scaffolded via npx @open-slide/cli init as a pnpm + Turbo monorepo.
contains: fixed 1920 x 1080 canvas; pages are arbitrary React components
in-browser inspector: click an element, @slide-comment markers, /apply-comments
present mode with next-slide preview, speaker notes and timer
export to static HTML, print-ready PDF, editable PPTX (in-browser)
assets manager with svgl brand logo search
deploy to Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Zeabur, Netlify or any static host
pnpm + Turbo monorepo: @open-slide/core runtime and @open-slide/cli scaffolder
